scope: Renderer output/input alias checks before writing

finding.before: Output could overwrite source Markdown before the post-render hash check, or overwrite other inputs / collide with PDF output.
finding.after: Resolved paths and existing samefile identities checked across all eight input types and both outputs before reading content or writing.

validation.red_regressions: All 13 collision variants failed on old renderer: mutation before rejection or no rejection.
validation.real_cli: Source-target collision refused without mutation; distinct HTML generated and verify_rendered_report passed.
validation.pdf_boundary: PDF writer mocked for path-collision tests; no actual PDF generation verified.

limits: report_renderer is PARTIAL: escaping, SVG, actual PDF, visual checks and failure publication remain unreviewed.
